mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_expense (report_id, item, amount) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{item}, #{amount})
INSERT INTO report_image (report_id, image_url, image_type) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageType})
mapper.select: SELECT expense_id, report_id, item, amount FROM report_expense WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY expense_id
SELECT image_id, report_id, image_url, image_type FROM report_image WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY image_id
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM campaign_report WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId}
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign_report SET content = #{content} WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
